in_marathi.name: Dhenuka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhenuka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhenuka is a Sanskrit name that means 'cow' or 'prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, cows are considered sacred and symbolize wealth, nourishment, and abundance. The name is also derived from the goddess Dhenu, who is the goddess of cows and prosperity.
